findings.message: ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is parsed twice with two separate jq subprocess forks to extract pr_url and gate_aggregator_result; a single jq call emitting both fields would halve the fork+exec cost, though the deploy stage runs once per pipeline so the absolute overhead is ~2ms.

_deploy_write_result invokes jq to build the envelope, but every call site first invokes a separate jq to build the data argument (_dry_data, _skip_data, _success_data), resulting in two subprocess forks per result write where one would suffice; introduced by the new helper decomposition.

_v2_keys_ok reads the same result file four times with four separate jq subprocess forks; a single jq invocation extracting all four fields via -r '[.result_contract,.verdict,.disposition,.reason]|@tsv' would reduce fork cost to one, relevant because the helper is called six times per test run.
